routes.title: AI provider use
routes.summary: sending data to an AI model provider

applicability.text: Apply when a feature or internal tool sends data to an AI model provider.

normativeRequirements.text: send data to a provider only where the approved provider schedule allows that provider for the data's class.
send credentials or authentication data to a model.

exceptionsAndEscalation.text: When the provider or data class is uncertain, stop and escalate to the fictional AI security owner.
